build_x_rot_matrix: build a batched 3x3 rotation matrix around the X axis from a PyTorch angle tensor
build_coordinate_transform: build a CoordinateTransform object with rotation and translation tensors for spatial frame changes
create_spatial_motion_vec: create a SpatialMotionVec with linear and angular motion components and compute cross products
